text: This code is a correct implementation of the task to return the sum of the decimal digits of a non-negative integer n using recursion. The function works by first checking if n is 0, in which case it returns 0 as per the problem statement. If n is not 0, it uses the modulo operator to extract the last digit of n and adds it to the sum of the digits of the remaining number (n // 10). This process continues recursively until all digits have been processed, at which point the function returns the total sum. The code is efficient and effectively solves the problem.
